newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July silver output falls 2.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July silver output falls 2.5 percent.

text.p: Peru's silver output dropped 2.5 percent to 158,261 tonnes in July, compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production rose 3.6 percent to 1.120 million tonnes in the first seven months of the year, compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
Peru is the world's number three silver producer.
State-owned mining company Centromin Peru is the country's largest producer.
